dataset_name: PackSho FSSAI Labelling and Display Rules
source_title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
amendment_history: Principal regulations: Gazette notification F. No. 1-94/FSSAI/SP(Labelling)/2014(Pt-2), dated 17 Nov 2020.
Amended by F. No. Std/SP-08/A-1.2019/N-02, dated 10 Sept 2021.
Amended by F. No. Std/SP-08/A-1.2021/N-01, dated 09 Sept 2022.
Amended by F. No. Std/SP-08/A-1-2020/N-01, dated 11 Oct 2022.
Chapter 3 food-service compliance date: 1 July 2022, per Direction F.No.REG/L&D-Extension/FSSAI-2021 dated 22 Oct 2021.

rules.requirement: Every pre-packaged food must carry all required label information unless exempted.
rules.description: All applicable mandatory label information must be present.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Mandatory label information must be shown to the consumer before sale through e-commerce, except batch/lot number, best before, use-by/expiry, and manufacture/packing date.
rules.description: Pre-sale digital disclosure is required for the specified mandatory information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Batch/lot, best before, use-by/expiry and manufacture/packing date are excluded from the pre-sale requirement.

rules.requirement: Labels must not be false, misleading, deceptive, or create an erroneous impression.
rules.description: Claims and presentation must not mislead consumers.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Required declarations shall be in English or Hindi in Devanagari script; additional languages may be used if they do not contradict the English/Hindi text.
rules.description: Language compliance can be checked from OCR/text where detectable.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: The label shall be affixed so it cannot become separated from the container.
rules.description: Physical attachment requires visual/physical review.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Label content must be clear, unambiguous, prominent, conspicuous, indelible and legible under normal conditions.
rules.description: Legibility is partly visual and physical.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: An outer wrapper/container displayed for retail sale must repeat required declarations unless transparent and inner declarations are readable through it.
rules.description: Outer packaging must preserve access to required declarations.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: Retail packages with an outer wrapper/container
rules.exceptions: Transparent wrappers have the stated exception; transparent multi-unit packs must show at least one full retail-unit label.

rules.requirement: The name of the food must indicate its true nature and appear on the Front of Pack.
rules.description: Use the established regulatory name where one exists; otherwise use a common/usual name or descriptive statement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Coined/fanciful/brand/trade names may be additional subject to applicable claims rules.

rules.requirement: Except for single-ingredient foods, a list of ingredients with an appropriate title such as Ingredients/List of Ingredients must be declared.
rules.description: Ingredient list is mandatory for multi-ingredient foods.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: Foods containing more than one ingredient

rules.requirement: Ingredients must be listed in descending order of composition by weight or volume at manufacture.
rules.description: The displayed order should correspond to composition.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Requires composition data to fully verify.

rules.requirement: Carried-over food additives performing a technological function must be listed.
rules.description: Applicable carried-over additives must appear in the ingredient list.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Specific names must be used for ingredients, subject to the listed permitted class-title cases.
rules.description: Ingredient naming must follow the permitted nomenclature.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Certain listed classes may use class titles.

rules.requirement: Compound ingredients must be declared by specific name with a bracketed sub-ingredient list in descending proportion, or by listing all sub-ingredients individually.
rules.description: Compound ingredients require appropriate sub-ingredient disclosure.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Compound ingredients below 5% have the stated exception except additives with a technological function.

rules.requirement: Added water must be declared except where it forms part of a compound ingredient or evaporates during manufacture.
rules.description: Water declaration depends on the stated exceptions.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Reconstituted dehydrated/condensed foods must declare ingredients in descending order and carry a prepared-as-directed statement.
rules.description: Reconstitution instructions form part of the declaration.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: The percentage of an ingredient must be disclosed when it is emphasized on the label or is essential to characterize the food and omission would mislead.
rules.description: Quantitative ingredient declaration is required in the specified cases.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Specified flavouring/spice, non-misleading name reference, drained net weight, specific regulation, serving suggestion and micronutrient exceptions.

rules.requirement: Mandatory nutrition information shall be declared per 100g/100ml and per serving, including applicable percentage contribution to RDA.
rules.description: Nutrition information uses the prescribed reference bases.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Energy value shall be declared in kcal.
rules.description: Energy is a mandatory nutrition field.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Protein, carbohydrate, total sugars and added sugars shall be declared in the prescribed units.
rules.description: Core macronutrient fields.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Total fat, saturated fat and trans fat shall be declared as applicable; saturated/trans fat may be stated as not more than and are required where total fat exceeds 0.5%.
rules.description: Fat declarations follow the stated applicability.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Cholesterol shall be declared for products with animal-origin fat and total fat above 0.5%.
rules.description: Cholesterol declaration is conditional.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Sodium shall be declared in milligrams.
rules.description: Sodium is a mandatory nutrition field where nutrition labelling applies.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Serving size shall be given in grams/millilitres and the number of servings per package shall be declared.
rules.description: Household measures may additionally be used.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Foods claiming nutrient enrichment must declare the quantities of added nutrients.
rules.description: Enrichment claims trigger added-nutrient disclosure.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Specified foods are exempt from mandatory nutrition labelling, including certain single-ingredient/unprocessed foods, plain drinking water, herbs/spices, salt, table-top sweeteners, coffee/chicory extracts, tea/herbal infusions, vinegar, flavourings/additives/processing aids/gelatine/yeast, chewing/bubble gum, alcoholic beverages and FSDU/FSMP products.
rules.description: Applicability must be determined before failing a nutrition rule.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Nutrition information becomes required if a nutrition/health claim is made.

rules.requirement: Specified edible oils/fats and foods using them must declare trans/saturated fat and the prescribed mono/polyunsaturated, omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acid information.
rules.description: Enhanced fat-profile declaration applies to specified products.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: Specified oils, fats and foods using them

rules.requirement: Declared nutrient values may deviate by up to minus 10% from the label value within the declared shelf life.
rules.description: Laboratory verification is needed for full compliance.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Energy calculation shall use the prescribed factors: carbohydrate 4, polyols except erythritol 2, erythritol 0, protein 4, fat 9, alcohol 7, organic acid 3 and dietary fibre 2 kcal/g.
rules.description: Calculated energy should follow the stated factors.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Protein shall be calculated as Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen × 6.25, or 6.38 for milk, unless a scientifically justified different factor is used.
rules.description: Protein calculation uses the prescribed factors.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Nutrition information may additionally be provided through Barcode/GTIN.
rules.description: Barcode/GTIN can supplement nutrition information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Additional rather than replacement use unless another provision permits it.

rules.requirement: Non-vegetarian food shall carry the prescribed brown filled triangle inside a brown-outlined square.
rules.description: Symbol detection is visual.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Specified exemptions include mineral water, packaged drinking water, carbonated water, alcoholic beverages, liquid milk, milk powders and honey.

rules.requirement: Vegetarian food shall carry the prescribed green filled circle inside a green-outlined square.
rules.description: Symbol detection is visual.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Egg-only non-vegetarian products may additionally carry the prescribed text declaration.
rules.description: Text is additional to the symbol.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Veg/non-veg symbol must be prominent on the principal display panel, on a contrasting background, close to the product/brand name on the Front of Pack; it is also required on pamphlets, leaflets and advertisements.
rules.description: Placement requires image/layout review.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For PDP area Up to 100 cm², minimum veg/non-veg symbol sizes are circle diameter 3 mm, triangle side 2.5 mm, and square side 6 mm.
rules.description: Minimum symbol dimensions are determined by PDP area.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For PDP area 100–500 cm², minimum veg/non-veg symbol sizes are circle diameter 4 mm, triangle side 3.5 mm, and square side 8 mm.
rules.description: Minimum symbol dimensions are determined by PDP area.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For PDP area 500–2500 cm², minimum veg/non-veg symbol sizes are circle diameter 6 mm, triangle side 5 mm, and square side 12 mm.
rules.description: Minimum symbol dimensions are determined by PDP area.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For PDP area Above 2500 cm², minimum veg/non-veg symbol sizes are circle diameter 8 mm, triangle side 7 mm, and square side 16 mm.
rules.description: Minimum symbol dimensions are determined by PDP area.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Functional class plus specific name or INS number must be declared in the ingredient list.
rules.description: Additive identification must include the required functional class and name/number.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Artificial flavouring shall use the common name; natural/nature-identical flavouring shall use the applicable class name.
rules.description: Flavour declarations depend on flavour type.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Brand owner's name and complete address must be declared with an applicable qualifying expression such as Manufactured by, Marketed by, Manufactured & Marketed by, or Packed & Marketed by.
rules.description: Alcoholic beverages have additional permitted expressions.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Alcoholic beverages have the listed alternative expressions.

rules.requirement: Imported food must show the Indian importer's name and address.
rules.description: Importer identification is mandatory for imported food.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Food manufactured abroad but packed/bottled in India must show country of origin, importer's address and India packing/bottling premises address.
rules.description: Imported/locally packed products have additional address/origin requirements.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: FSSAI logo and licence number shall be displayed in contrast to the background.
rules.description: Logo and licence number are mandatory label information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Brand owner's licence number is required; manufacturer/marketer/packer/bottler licence number is also required when different.
rules.description: Multiple FBO roles may require additional licence numbers.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Imported products must display FSSAI logo, licence number and importer name/address.
rules.description: Imported products have additional FSSAI identification.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Every FBO must display Registration/License No. or Food Safety Display Board at all premises.
rules.description: Premises-level compliance is outside ordinary package OCR.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Fortified and organic foods must carry the applicable Schedule-I logo.
rules.description: Logo requirements depend on product status.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Net quantity, Retail Sale Price and Consumer Care details shall follow the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and its Rules.
rules.description: These fields are governed by Legal Metrology requirements.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Every label shall carry lot/code/batch identification.
rules.description: Traceability identifier is mandatory.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Date of manufacture/packaging and Expiry/Use by are mandatory; Best before is optional/additional.
rules.description: Required date marking must be present as applicable.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For shelf life up to 3 months, date shall use DD/MM/YY.
rules.description: Date format depends on shelf life.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For shelf life over 3 months, month and year shall be declared in the prescribed manner; DD/MM/YY is also permitted.
rules.description: Month should use capital letters and a minimum three-letter abbreviation.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Special storage conditions must be declared where date validity depends on them, including post-opening storage where applicable.
rules.description: Storage instructions may be mandatory.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Expiry indication is not required for specified products including fresh fruits/vegetables/unpeeled potatoes, wines, alcoholic beverages ≥10% ABV, vinegar, sugar-boiled confectionery, food-grade industrial salt, solid sugars and chewing/bubble gum.
rules.description: Applicability must be determined before failing the expiry rule.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Date of manufacture/packaging and Expiry/Use by must be grouped together at one place.
rules.description: Placement requires layout review.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Date and time of manufacture are required for meals served on airlines, railways and mobile catering.
rules.description: Specific catering products require date and time.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Imported foods are additionally governed by FSS (Import) Regulations, 2017.
rules.description: Import applicability must be considered.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Country of origin is mandatory on imported food labels.
rules.description: Origin declaration must be present.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: If processing in a second country changes the HS Code at six-digit level, that country becomes the origin for labelling purposes.
rules.description: Origin determination may require supply-chain information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: Imported food processed in a second country

rules.requirement: Instructions for use/reconstitution shall be included where needed for proper use or health/safety, such as Refrigerate after opening.
rules.description: Use instructions are conditional.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Specified allergens must be separately declared using a Contains statement and allergen name.
rules.description: Specified allergens include gluten cereals, crustaceans, milk, eggs, fish, peanuts/tree nuts, soybeans and sulphite ≥10 mg/kg.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Cross-contamination allergens may be declared using May Contain.
rules.description: Advisory cross-contamination statement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Allergen declaration is not required for specified oils/distilled alcoholic beverages derived from allergens, where the product itself is the allergen, or raw agricultural commodities.
rules.description: Applicability requires ingredient/product context.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Retail food products not meant for human consumption must bear a black cross inside a square with black outline.
rules.description: Symbol detection is visual.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: Retail food products not meant for human consumption

rules.requirement: Required information may be grouped in one place, or pre-printed information may be grouped separately from online/non-pre-printed information as permitted.
rules.description: Display arrangement is layout-dependent.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For rectangular packages, PDP area must be at least 40% of height × width of the largest panel.
rules.description: Requires package dimensions.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For cylindrical/round/oval packages, PDP area must be at least 40% of height × average circumference.
rules.description: Requires package dimensions.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For other shapes, PDP area must be at least 20% of total surface area.
rules.description: Requires package dimensions.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Packages of capacity ≤10 cm³ may use a card/tape affixed to the package as the PDP.
rules.description: Small package display exception.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Minimum numeral/letter height on PDP is 1/2/3/6 mm for areas up to 200, 200–500, 500–2500 and above 2500 cm² respectively in the normal case.
rules.description: Font sizing is based on PDP area.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Minimum numeral/letter height on PDP is 2/4/5/8 mm for areas up to 200, 200–500, 500–2500 and above 2500 cm² respectively for blown/moulded/perforated containers.
rules.description: Special container construction has larger minimums.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Net weight, MRP, expiry/best-before/use-by date and consumer-care details follow Legal Metrology sizing instead of the general PDP font table.
rules.description: These fields use Legal Metrology sizing requirements.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Declarations on the crown/closure of a returnable glass bottle must have numeral/letter size at least 1 mm.
rules.description: Specific closure requirement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Letter/numeral width must be at least one-third of height, except 1, i, I and l.
rules.description: Proportion can be checked only with image/typography analysis.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Exceptions for 1, i, I and l.

rules.requirement: Where food contains ingredients/additives listed in Schedule II, the applicable declaration must be prominently shown.
rules.description: Schedule II applicability depends on product composition.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Schedule II declarations require minimum numeral/letter size of 3 mm based on letter l.
rules.description: Physical font verification.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Packages ≤30 cm² containing caloric/non-caloric sweeteners may use 1 mm.

rules.requirement: Packages ≤100 cm² are exempt from specified ingredient, lot/batch/code, nutrition, irradiation, additive, licence/logo, importer address and instructions-for-use requirements.
rules.description: Exemption is conditional and multi-unit packages must carry the information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Information must appear on the multi-unit package.

rules.requirement: Packages <30 cm² may omit manufacture date and use-by/expiry, subject to the multi-unit requirement.
rules.description: Very small package date exemption.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Reusable/refillable liquid bottles are exempt from ingredient list, but nutritional information remains required.
rules.description: Specific bottle exemption.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For shelf life ≤7 days, manufacture date may be omitted but expiry/use-by remains mandatory.
rules.description: Short shelf-life exception.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Food for immediate consumption must display the specified minimum information at point of sale, including applicable Schedule II declarations, allergen information and veg/non-veg logo.
rules.description: Applies to listed hotels, food service vendors, caterers, halwais, hospitals, religious gatherings and airline/railway/mobile catering.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Vending machines have additional display requirements.

rules.requirement: Vending machines must show Regulation 5(3) nutrition information on the machine exterior or through poster/leaflet/container label.
rules.description: Nutrition information must be accessible.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Brand owner's address and differing manufacturer/marketer/packer/bottler licence number may be provided via Barcode/GTIN instead of on-label.
rules.description: Specified label information can be supplied through Barcode/GTIN.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For assorted packs, declared shelf life is the shelf life of the product with the earliest expiry among the products inside.
rules.description: Shelf-life determination requires pack contents.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: FBOs with a Central licence or 10 or more outlets must display calorific value in kcal per serving and serving size on menu cards/boards/booklets.
rules.description: Chapter 3 food-service display requirement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: FBO with Central licence OR 10+ outlets

rules.requirement: Covered food service establishments must display the prescribed reference statement that an average active adult requires 2,000 kcal energy per day and needs may vary.
rules.description: Reference statement accompanies calorie information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Covered food service establishments must display food allergen information against menu items; symbols may be used.
rules.description: Menu allergen information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Covered food service establishments must display veg/non-veg logo against menu items.
rules.description: Menu vegetarian status.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Food service display requirements do not apply to event caterers/premises operating less than 60 days per year, free self-serve condiments not on the menu, and special-order/customized items.
rules.description: Applicability exceptions must be checked.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Covered establishments must provide nutrition information, applicable Schedule II requirements and organic claims information on request through booklets, handouts or website.
rules.description: Consumer-request information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: 25% deviation is allowed for nutritional information.

rules.requirement: E-commerce FBOs must source required food information from the actual FBO and publish it on their website.
rules.description: Online information must reflect actual FBO information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Non-retail packaged food containers must carry name of food, net quantity, FSSAI logo/licence number, date marking, lot number, manufacturer/packer name/address and country of origin where imported.
rules.description: Core non-retail label set.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: For non-retail sale, ingredient list, veg/non-veg declaration and nutritional information may appear in accompanying documents as specified.
rules.description: Supporting information may accompany the package.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Every package meant for non-retail sale must bear NOT FOR RETAIL SALE.
rules.description: Required restriction statement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Food additives for retail sale follow the labelling regulations generally, except sub-regulations 5(1) and 5(3).
rules.description: Retail additives have modified application.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Food additives must use the specific name under applicable food-product standards, or international/common name if unlisted; synthetic colours need chemical name and colour index.
rules.description: Additive nomenclature requirement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Multiple additives must be listed in descending order by weight/volume; quantity/proportion must be stated where quantitative limits apply.
rules.description: Additive ordering and quantity.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Food additives must be prominently marked FOR USE IN FOOD.
rules.description: Required additive-use statement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Flavour mixtures may use flavour/flavouring qualified by natural, nature-identical, artificial or a combination as applicable.
rules.description: Flavour modifier is not required to carry the qualifier.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.applicability: Flavour mixtures sold as food additives
rules.exceptions: Qualifier not required for flavour modifiers.

rules.requirement: Non-retail food additives follow Chapter 4 and Regulation 10 except the nutritional information clause.
rules.description: Non-retail additives follow non-retail rules with the stated exception.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: These additive labelling regulations supersede repugnant labelling requirements under other FSS Act regulations.
rules.description: Conflict-resolution provision.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Fortified food must state fortified with the fortificant name and carry the +F logo.
rules.description: Logo and wording requirement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: The tagline Sampoorna Poshan Swasth Jeevan may be used with fortified-food labelling.
rules.description: Optional tagline.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: Certified organic food must carry the Jaivik Bharat logo.
rules.description: Organic certification logo requirement.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Applies under the referenced organic-food regulations.

rules.requirement: POLYOLS_10
rules.description: Foods containing ≥10% polyols must bear: Polyols may have laxative effect.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: POLYDEXTROSE_10
rules.description: Foods containing ≥10% polydextrose must bear: Polydextrose may have laxative effect.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: CAFFEINE
rules.description: Food containing added caffeine must bear: CONTAINS CAFFEINE.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: ISOMALTULOSE
rules.description: Food containing Isomaltulose must carry the prescribed Isomaltulose declaration with kcal per 100g/100ml.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: SORBITOL_10
rules.description: Food containing ≥10% sorbitol or sorbitol syrup must carry the prescribed laxative/bloating/diarrhoea and calcium-absorption warning.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: MAIDA_TREATED
rules.description: Treated maida must bear the prescribed refined wheat flour/bakery-use declaration.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: GLUCOSE_SYRUP_SO2
rules.description: Dried glucose syrup with sulphur dioxide >40 ppm must bear the prescribed bakery/sugar-confectionery-use declaration.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Dried glucose syrup with SO₂ >40 ppm

rules.requirement: FRUIT_SQUASH_SALT
rules.description: Fruit squash containing additional sodium/potassium salt must declare the additional salt.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Fruit squash with added sodium/potassium salt

rules.requirement: FLAVOUR_EMULSION
rules.description: Flavour emulsion/paste intended for beverages must carry the prescribed beverage-use declaration.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: WAX_CHEESE
rules.description: Wax-coated cheese must declare that the coated wax is to be removed before consumption.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: FROZEN_DESSERT_OIL
rules.description: Frozen Dessert/Frozen Confection must declare Made with ___ Edible Vegetable Oil/Vegetable Fat.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: COMMON_SALT_NONFOOD
rules.description: Common Salt for specified non-direct-consumption uses must carry the applicable prescribed statement with inapplicable uses struck out.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: WAX_FRUIT
rules.description: Wax-coated fresh fruit must declare COATED WITH WAX and the name of the wax.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: GELATIN
rules.description: Gelatin intended for human consumption must carry Gelatin Food Grade.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: PAN_MASALA
rules.description: Pan Masala must carry CHEWING OF PAN MASALA IS INJURIOUS TO HEALTH and the warning must cover 50% of the front of pack.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: SUPARI
rules.description: Supari must carry CHEWING OF SUPARI IS INJURIOUS TO HEALTH.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: SWEETENERS
rules.description: Specified table-top sweeteners must state applicable sweetener name, purity/weight percentage and population-specific warnings.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.notes: Applicability depends on actual sweetener.

rules.requirement: SWEETENER_MIXTURE
rules.description: Food containing a mixture of specified sweeteners must declare the admixture and comply with individual sweetener labelling requirements.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.notes: Packages up to 100 cm² have the stated 1.5 mm minimum text size.

rules.requirement: NONCALORIC_SWEETENER
rules.description: Foods permitted to contain specified non-caloric sweeteners must carry CONTAIN NON-CALORIC SWEETENER.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: MSG
rules.description: Food containing added monosodium glutamate must carry the prescribed MSG declaration and infant/pregnancy warning.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: WATER_BOTTLE_CRUSH
rules.description: One-time-use plastic bottles for packaged/mineral water must carry the prescribed crush/disposal declaration.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: PLANT_STANOL
rules.description: Foods containing added plant stanol esters must declare content and the prescribed medical/age/daily-consumption warnings.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: TREHALOSE
rules.description: Specified foods with added trehalose must bear Contains Trehalose.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: DEXTRIN_FIBRE
rules.description: Specified foods with added dextrin-soluble fibre must declare Contains Dietary Fibre (Dextrin) with the source.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: PLANT_STEROL
rules.description: Products containing added plant sterol must declare content and prescribed medical, age and daily-consumption warnings.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: IRRADIATED_STATEMENT
rules.description: Irradiated food must carry a written treatment statement close to the name of the food.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: RADURA_BLOCK
rules.description: Specified irradiated food must carry the Radura logo and the prescribed radiation-processing, product, licence, batch identification and processing-date information.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: EDIBLE_OIL_PROHIBITED_WORDS
rules.description: Edible refined vegetable oils and fats must not use Super-Refined, Extra-Refined, Micro-Refined, Double refined or Ultra-Refined.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Edible refined vegetable oils and fats

rules.requirement: VANASPATI_RICE_BRAN
rules.description: Vanaspati containing more than 30% rice bran oil must carry the prescribed rice-bran declaration.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: PHYSICAL_RICE_BRAN
rules.description: Physically refined rice bran oil used in Vanaspati must be declared as Physically Refined Rice Bran Oil in the ingredient list.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.exceptions: Vanaspati using physically refined rice bran oil

rules.requirement: ANNATTO_OIL
rules.description: Vegetable oils containing annatto colour must declare Contains Annatto colour.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: MULTISOURCE_OIL
rules.description: Admixture of edible oils must declare MULTI-SOURCE EDIBLE OIL, each oil name/nature/percentage by weight and NOT TO BE SOLD LOOSE.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
rules.notes: Font sizes vary by pack size.

rules.requirement: MULTISOURCE_FONT
rules.description: For multi-source edible oils, declaration font sizes scale by pack size: <1L at least 3 mm with statement ≥35 mm long and breakdown ≥2 mm; 1L–<5L at least 4 mm with statement ≥45 mm and breakdown ≥2.5 mm; ≥5L at least 10 mm with breakdown ≥3 mm.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: COFFEE_CHICORY
rules.description: Coffee-chicory mixtures must declare Coffee blended with Chicory plus coffee/chicory percentages; instant versions use the prescribed instant wording and percentages.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: MILK_INFANT_WARNING
rules.description: Specified reconstitutable milk powders/skimmed milk powder/condensed milk must state NOT TO BE USED FOR INFANTS BELOW SIX MONTHS.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: WATER_NO_MEDICINAL
rules.description: Packaged/mineral water labels must not make medicinal or health-effect claims.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: WATER_LOCALITY
rules.description: Locality/place names in water trade names are permitted only if the water is actually collected there.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: WATER_NO_MISLEADING
rules.description: Water labels must not contain misleading statements or pictorial devices about nature, origin, composition or properties.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: GLUTEN_FREE
rules.description: Gluten Free must appear immediately near the product name for applicable products.
rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)

rules.requirement: GLUTEN_SHARED_PLANT

rules.source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version-VII (03.04.2025)
